applies_to: Evolution Health EU and EEA, all levels of cover, all four areas
_comment: Carrier-specific commercial pricing rules. These are NOT global HAL
behaviour: every carrier sets its own family discount policy, so each
carrier that HAL quotes online needs its own file here. A carrier with
no file gets NO family discount (see carrier_pricing.py) — HAL must
never apply one insurer's commercial terms to another's rate table.

description: The discount is applied to the max_discounted_members highest-premium
lives only; any further life is charged the undiscounted rate.
In this rate table premium rises monotonically with age, so 'the four
oldest' and 'the four most expensive' are always the same set.
family_discount.verified_by: Chris Iatropoulos, against the Morgan Price quick-quote engine

verified_against.note: Same five lives as the previous row, entered in a different order. The member charged the full rate changed from the 4th-listed to the 2nd-listed, but in both cases it was the youngest child — which is why this is recorded as a rule and not an artefact of input ordering.

family_discount.unverified_behaviour: HAL declines to price online and routes to a broker rather than extrapolating the ladder.

instalment_loading._comment: Morgan Price administration fee for premium instalment facilities, quoted on every Evolution Health EU quick-quote PDF.
instalment_loading.applies_to_payment_methods: credit card and SEPA Direct Debit
instalment_loading.source: Morgan Price Evolution Health EU and EEA quick-quote PDF, 'Administration Fee' note

insurance_premium_tax._comment: Morgan Price quotes EXCLUDE insurance premium tax. The applicable rate depends on the country of residence and is not published in the rate workbook, so HAL must not compute it.
insurance_premium_tax.source: Morgan Price quick-quote PDF: 'Taxes are not included in your quote. In some countries an insurance premium tax will be payable on top of your insurance premium; it is calculated as a percentage of the premium.'
